biography: Born in Modena, the heart of Italian motorsport, Max Park's passion for racing ignited early. Growing up next to a small karting track, the roar of engines became his lullaby. He spent countless hours watching older kids race, dreaming of the day he could join them. At age 10, he finally got his chance, receiving a hand-me-down kart from a family friend. Despite its age, Max dominated local karting events, his raw talent shining through. He's now transitioning to single-seaters, competing in a regional Formula series as an independent driver. While struggling to secure consistent funding, Max's flashy driving style and undeniable charisma have already made him a fan favorite, hinting at a promising future if he can overcome the financial hurdles.
drivingStyle: Max is an aggressive and flamboyant driver, known for his late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes. He thrives under pressure, often pushing his car to the absolute limit, sometimes exceeding it. While incredibly quick, his aggressive style can lead to mistakes and inconsistent results. He's still learning to manage his tires effectively and refine his race craft, but his raw speed and fearless attitude make him a formidable opponent.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry from their karting days, Alessandro, a more calculated and consistent driver, often clashed with Max's aggressive style, leading to numerous on-track incidents.

Sofia, another rising star in the Formula series, represents the establishment with significant sponsor backing, while Max is the underdog. Their contrasting backgrounds and personalities fuel the rivalry both on and off the track.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks his grandmother knitted for him before every race.
Listens to Italian opera at full volume in the garage before getting into the car to 'channel the passion'.
Refuses to start a race without first eating a single, perfectly ripe peach.
famousQuote: "I don't brake, I persuade the car to slow down!"
careerHighlight: Winning the Modena Karting Championship at age 14, beating seasoned veterans despite having an inferior kart.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in his first Formula race due to an overly ambitious overtaking attempt, costing him valuable points and damaging his car.
